findings.current: Unable to bring themselves to say the name aloud, the two men merely mouthed the words and swallowed hard.
findings.defect: “Mouthed the words” implies that they silently articulated Mae Jonghak’s name. The source only says their mouths opened and closed soundlessly because they could not bring themselves to say it.
findings.rationale: 입만 벙긋거린 describes the physical motion of their mouths without establishing that they formed specific words.
findings.replacement: Unable to bring themselves to say the name aloud, the two men merely opened and closed their mouths before swallowing hard.

summary: The chapter is faithful overall, with one minor physical-action distortion.
